question: Does an empty generator-expression custom command still produce a failing Ninja command on current Windows CMake while the equivalent Linux Ninja build succeeds?

sources.name: CMake issue 24802
sources.claim: The reported failure concerns Ninja build statements generated from empty custom commands on Windows.

sources.name: Kitware/CMake GitHub mirror
sources.claim: Current public source mirror used for overlap and implementation mapping.

environment.runtime: preinstalled CMake and Ninja reported by the runner
environment.platform: windows-latest; Linux control executed separately on x86_64 Linux

distinguishing_outcomes.observation: Windows Ninja emits a working-directory-only command and the build fails to create a process.
distinguishing_outcomes.interpretation: Supports the reported Windows command-emission defect and justifies source/test mapping.

distinguishing_outcomes.observation: Windows Ninja completes both empty-command variants successfully.
distinguishing_outcomes.interpretation: Weakens the current-bug hypothesis; stop and retain a negative result unless another exact supported configuration reproduces it.

stop_condition: Stop after current Windows behavior is observed for the two bounded variants and compared with the successful Linux control; do not modify or contact upstream during this experiment.
network_policy: GitHub-hosted runner setup only; the reproducer itself performs no network access
